semesters.title: 1st Year · 1st Semester
semesters.subtitle: B.Sc. Engineering Curriculum (Session 2025–2026) · 15.00 Theory Credits + 3.75 Sessional Credits

courses.title: Electrical Circuits I
courses.overview: Circuit Variables and Elements, Basic Laws, Techniques for Circuit Analysis, DC Network Theorem, AC Network Theorem, and Sinusoidal Functions.

professor: Fundamentals of Electric Circuits by Charles K. Alexander and Matthew N. O. Sadiku
A Textbook of Electrical Technology (Vol. I) by B. L. Theraja and A. K. Theraja
syllabus: Alternating-current Circuits by G. F. Corcoran and R. M. Kerchner
Introduction to Electric Circuits by R. C. Dorf and J. A. Svoboda
Electrical Engineering by R. P. Ward
Fundamentals of Electricity and Magnetism by Arthur Kip
Introductory Circuit Analysis by Robert L. Boylestad

topics.label: Module 01
topics.title: Circuit Variables and Elements
topics.summary: Voltage, current, power, energy, independent and dependent sources, resistance, inductance and capacitance. Introduce to non-sinusoidal wave, calculation of RMS and average value for non-sinusoidal waveforms.

topics.label: Module 02
topics.title: Basic Laws
topics.summary: Ohm's law, Kirchhoff's current and voltage laws, Voltage divider and current divider rules, Delt-Wye equivalent circuits. Series, parallel and series-parallel circuits and their equivalents.

topics.label: Module 03
topics.title: Techniques for Circuit Analysis
topics.summary: Nodal and mesh analysis including supernode, supermesh. Techniques of General DC/AC Circuit Analysis (Containing both independent and dependent sources) Node-voltage method, Mesh-current method, Source Transformations.

topics.label: Module 04
topics.title: DC Network Theorem
topics.summary: Thevenin's theorem, Norton's theorem and superposition theorem with applications in circuits having independent and dependent sources, Millman's theorem, Substitution theorem, Maximum power transfer theorem and Reciprocity Theorem.

topics.label: Module 05
topics.title: AC Network Theorem
topics.summary: Thevenin's theorem, Norton's theorem, superposition theorem, Millman's theorem, Substitution theorem, Maximum power transfer theorem and Reciprocity Theorem.

topics.label: Module 06
topics.title: Sinusoidal Functions
topics.summary: Instantaneous current, voltage, power, effective current and voltage, phasors and complex quantities. Impedance, admittance, reactance, susceptance of RL, RC and RLC branches.

courses.title: Electrical Circuits I Sessional
courses.overview: Laboratory sessional experiments based on EECE 1111 (Electrical Circuits I).

professor: Fundamentals of Electric Circuits by Charles K. Alexander and Matthew N. O. Sadiku
syllabus: Introductory Circuit Analysis by Robert L. Boylestad

topics.label: Module 01
topics.title: Electrical Circuits I Laboratory Experiments
topics.summary: Experimental verification of Ohm's Law, KCL, KVL, Superposition, Thevenin's, Norton's, Maximum Power Transfer theorems, and RLC AC branch measurements.

courses.title: Physics
courses.overview: Electrostatic and Steady Electric Current, Magnetic Field and Electromagnetic Induction, Waves and Oscillations, Optics, Quantum Mechanics, Sound and Acoustics, and Thermoelectricity and Photoelectricity.

professor: Physics Part I and Part II by David Halliday and Robert Resnick
syllabus: Textbook of Optics by Francis A. Jenkins and Harvey E. White
Thermodynamics by F. W. Sears
Classical Thermodynamics by D. Elwell & A. J. Pointon
Modern Physics by A. Beiser
Electricity and Magnetism by Edward M. Purcell
Electricity and Magnetism by Stanley Ramsey
Oscillations and Waves: An Introduction by Richard Fitzpatrick
Waves and Oscillations by R. A. Waldron

topics.label: Module 01
topics.title: Electrostatic and Steady Electric Current
topics.summary: Electric field in dielectric media, Energy in an electrostatic field. Concept of electric current, Current density, Equation of continuity, Resistivity and conductivity, Electrostatic force, Electromotive force.

topics.label: Module 02
topics.title: Magnetic Field and Electromagnetic Induction
topics.summary: Magnetic induction, Magnetic force on a current, Torque on a current loop, Ampere's law, Biot-Savart law and its applications, Faraday's laws of electromagnetic induction, Lenz's law, Induced current and voltage, Self-inductance and mutual inductance, Inductor.

topics.label: Module 03
topics.title: Waves and Oscillations
topics.summary: Differential equation of simple harmonic oscillator, Total energy and average energy. Combination of simple harmonic oscillations, Spring mass system, Torsional pendulum, Two body oscillation, Reduced mass, Damped oscillation, Forced oscillation, Resonance, Progressive wave, Power and intensity of wave, Stationary wave, Group and phase velocities.

topics.label: Module 04
topics.title: Optics
topics.summary: Theories of light, Interference of light, Young's double slit experiment, Diffraction by single slit, Diffraction at double slit, Diffraction grating, Polarization, Classification and uses of polarization, Brewster's law, Nicol Prism.

topics.label: Module 05
topics.title: Quantum Mechanics
topics.summary: Wave function and wave equation, Time dependent and time independent Schrodinger's equation, De-Broglie waves, Uncertainty principle, Photoelectric effect, Quantum theory of light, Compton effect.

topics.label: Module 06
topics.title: Sound and Acoustics
topics.summary: Simple harmonic motion, Wave equation, Principle of superposition. Beats, Dispersion, Phase and group velocities, Doppler's effect, Free and forced vibrations, Reverberation, Noise insulation and reduction, Compound absorption, Sound distribution, Room acoustics, Recording.

topics.label: Module 07
topics.title: Thermoelectricity and Photoelectricity
topics.summary: Thermal electromotive forces, Seebeck effect and Peltier effect, Thermocouple and Thermo-emf, Laws of photoemission and Einstein's equation, Photoelectric cell and its use.

courses.title: Engineering Graphics
courses.overview: Introduction to orthographic projections, Drawing standards and practices, and Introduction to computer aided design (CAD).

syllabus: Engineering Graphics (3rd Edition) by Frederick E. Giesecke, Alva Mitchell, Henry C. Spencer, Ivan L. Hill, Robert O. Loving and John Thomas Dygdon
Engineering Drawing (2nd Edition) by Frank Zozzora

topics.label: Module 01
topics.title: Introduction to Orthographic Projections
topics.summary: Scale drawing, Sectional view, Isometric views, Missing line, Auxiliary view, Pictorial views.

topics.label: Module 02
topics.title: Drawing Standards and Practices
topics.summary: Interpenetrating of surfaces, Development of surfaces, Machine drawings and Technical sketching.

topics.label: Module 03
topics.title: Introduction to Computer Aided Design (CAD)
topics.summary: Project on Engineering Drawing and CAD using Contemporary CAD tools.

courses.title: English
courses.overview: Introduction, Communicative English, Paragraph Writing, Essay Writing, Reading comprehension, Business Writing, Letter Writing, and Report writing.

syllabus: Basic English Grammar by Schrampfer Azar
Advanced Grammar in Use With answers by Martin Hewings
Communicating Handbook by Loes Van
English for Business Communication Student’s Book by Simon Sweeney
Technical English: Writing, Reading and Speaking (8th Edition) by Nell Ann Pickett
Cambridge English for Engineering Student’s Book with Audio CDs (2) by A. S. Hornby

topics.label: Module 01
topics.title: Introduction
topics.summary: Parts of speech (Changing), Sentence making rules, different types of sentences, Tense, right forms of verbs, verb conjugation, Transformation of sentences: Different types of sentences - Converting degree, Appropriate preposition, Idioms & Phrase, Voice, Narration, Correction of sentences, WH Question, Completing sentences, Synonyms and Antonyms.

topics.label: Module 02
topics.title: Communicative English
topics.summary: Introductions oneself, Conversation & Dialogue on recent topic, Group Discussion, Notations & Functions.

topics.label: Module 03
topics.title: Paragraph Writing
topics.summary: Amplification of Ideas, Structure and classifications, Topic Sentence, Topic Developers, Topic Termination, Open-ended paragraph, Close-ended paragraph.

topics.label: Module 04
topics.title: Essay Writing
topics.summary: Hints given essay, without hints essay, Free hand Essay writing on current Issues.

topics.label: Module 05
topics.title: Reading Comprehension
topics.summary: Precise writing, Vocabulary building, Synonym & Antonym, Use of words in different Parts of speech, True-false (Yes/No/Not given), Fill in the blanks, Tree Chart, flow chart.

topics.label: Module 06
topics.title: Business Writing
topics.summary: Agenda, Notice, Memo, Meeting Minutes, Quotation, Tender.

topics.label: Module 07
topics.title: Letter Writing
topics.summary: Job application, Resume, Formal & Informal letter, Letter to Newspaper.

topics.label: Module 08
topics.title: Report Writing
topics.summary: Technical Report, Lab report, Newspaper report.

courses.title: Differential Calculus and Analytical Geometry
courses.overview: Differential Calculus (Functions, Limit and Continuity, Differentiability, Successive Differentiations & Leibniz Theorem, Mean Value Theorems, Tangents, Curvature, Partial Derivatives, Euler’s Theorem, Jacobian & Hessian) and Analytical Geometry (2D/3D Co-ordinate Systems, Pair of Straight Lines, Conics, Circles, Planes, Conicoids & Sphere).

professor: Calculus and Analytical Geometry by H. Anton
Co-ordinate Geometry and Vector Analysis by Rahman and Bhattacharjee
syllabus: Analytic Geometry of Conic Sections by E. H. Askwith
Calculus and Analytic Geometry by G. B. Thomas and R. L. Finney
Differential Calculus by J. Edwards
Advanced Calculus by M. R. Spiegel
Calculus by F. Ayres

topics.label: Module 01
topics.title: Functions, Limit and Continuity
topics.summary: 1.1 Functions: kinds (polynomial, rational, transcendental, even, odd, periodic), Domain, range, inverse function and graphs of standard functions. 1.2 Limit and continuity: epsilon-delta definition and geometric interpretations.

topics.label: Module 02
topics.title: Differentiability, Successive Differentiations and Leibniz Theorem
topics.summary: 2.1 Differentiability: Elementary properties, geometric interpretation, Absolute maxima and minima. 2.2 Successive differentiations and Leibniz theorem.

topics.label: Module 03
topics.title: Mean Value Theorems, Series Expansion and Maxima/Minima
topics.summary: 3.1 Rolle's Theorem, Mean value Theorem, Taylor's and Maclaurin's Theorems, approximation of a function by polynomials and series, indeterminate forms and L'Hospital's rule. 3.2 Application of derivative for curve tracing, maxima and minima of functions of a single variable.

topics.label: Module 04
topics.title: Tangent, Normal, Curvature and Functions of Double Variables
topics.summary: 4.1 Tangent, normal, Asymptote, curvature. 4.2 Function of double variables, domain, continuity, partial derivatives and total derivative, Euler's Theorem, Jacobian and Hessian.

topics.label: Module 05
topics.title: Co-ordinate Systems and Pair of Straight Lines
topics.summary: 1.1 Co-ordinate systems: Cartesian co-ordinates, Polar co-ordinates, Parameters, Standard Equations in different co-ordinates systems and their parametric representations, Transformation of co-ordinates. 1.2 Pair of straight lines: Condition for a general equation of 2nd degree in two variables to represent pair of straight lines, Properties of pair of straight lines.

topics.label: Module 06
topics.title: Conics and System of Circles
topics.summary: 2.1 Conics: The general equation of 2nd degree in two variables and reduction to standard forms, identification of conics, Parabola, Ellipse and Hyperbola: Derivation of standard forms and properties. 2.2 System of circles: Circles and system of circles, General properties, Orthogonality of two circles, limiting circle, radical axis, co-axial circles.

topics.label: Module 07
topics.title: 3D Co-ordinate Systems, Planes and Straight Lines
topics.summary: 3.1 Co-ordinate systems: Cartesian, Cylindrical and Spherical systems, Direction cosines and direction ratios, Projection, Angle between two lines. 3.2 Planes and Straight lines: Planes, different form of planes and conversions, angle between two planes, Lines, different form of lines and conversions, angle between two lines, angle between a line and a plane, Plane containing a line, plane containing two lines, shortest distance between two lines.

topics.label: Module 08
topics.title: Conicoids and Sphere
topics.summary: 4.1 The general equations of second degree and reduction to standard forms, identification of conicoids, cone, Generators, condition for a general equation of second degree to represent Cylinder or Cone, right circular cone, right circular Cylinder. 4.2 Sphere: Equation of sphere, a plane and a sphere, a line and a sphere, plane of contact, tangent planes, polar planes, angle of intersections of two spheres, condition of orthogonality, radical line, plane and centers, co-axial spheres.

courses.title: Physical and Inorganic Chemistry
courses.overview: Electrochemistry, Electrochemical Cells, Chemical Equilibrium, Chemical kinetics, Solution and Colloid, Atomic Structure, Periodic Classification of Elements, Electronic Theory of Valence and Chemical Bonding, and Chemistry of Transition Elements, Lanthanides and Actinides.

professor: Modern Inorganic Chemistry by R. D. Madan
syllabus: Principles of Physical Chemistry by M. M. Haque and M. A. Nawab
Fundamental Concepts in Inorganic Chemistry by Esmarch S. Gilreath
Physical Chemistry by G. M. Barrow
Physical Chemistry by W. J. Moore
Physical Chemistry by Keith J. Laidler, John H. Meiser
Elementary Physical Chemistry by S. R. Palit
Modern Inorganic Chemistry by S. Z. Haider
Chemical Bonding by Audrey L. Companion
Basic Inorganic Chemistry by F. Albert Cotton, G. Wilkinson, P. L. Gaus
Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding by Donald K. Sebera

topics.label: Module 01
topics.title: Electrochemistry
topics.summary: Conductors, Electrolytes and Electrolysis, Faraday's Laws of Electrolysis, Electrolytic Conductance, Theories for Electrolytic Conductance, Ionic Mobility, Kohlrausch's Law, Transference Number.

topics.label: Module 02
topics.title: Electrochemical Cells (Electrolytic and Galvanic/Voltaic)
topics.summary: Electrode Reaction and Potentials, Reference Electrode, Reversible and Concentration Cells.

topics.label: Module 03
topics.title: Chemical Equilibrium
topics.summary: Reversible and Irreversible Reaction, Chemical Equilibrium and its Dynamic Nature, Characteristics, Laws of Mass Action and Equilibrium Constant Kc, Kp and Kx, Le-Chatelier's Principles and Applications.

topics.label: Module 04
topics.title: Chemical Kinetics
topics.summary: Rate of Chemical Reaction, Order and Molecularity of Reactions, Different Types of Rate Expressions, Methods of Determining Rate and Order, Effect of Temperature on Reaction Rate and Energy of Activation.

topics.label: Module 05
topics.title: Solution and Colloid
topics.summary: Different Types of Solution, Concentration Units, Colloid and Colloidal Solution-Classification, Preparation, Purification, Properties, Protective Action and Application of Colloids.

topics.label: Module 06
topics.title: Atomic Structure
topics.summary: Dalton's Atomic Theory, Fundamental Particles, Elementary Ideas on Rutherford Atom Model and Bohr Atom Model, Quantum Numbers, Shape of Atomic Orbitals, Pauli's Exclusion Principle, Electronic Configuration of Elements.

topics.label: Module 07
topics.title: Periodic Classification of Elements
topics.summary: Modern Periodic Table, Periodic Classification of Elements, Correlation of Periodic Classification of Elements with Electronic Configuration, Investigation on Some Periodic Properties, Atomic and Ionic Radius, Ionization Potential, Electron Affinity and Electronegativity.

topics.label: Module 08
topics.title: Electronic Theory of Valence and Chemical Bonding
topics.summary: Different Types of Chemical Bonds (Ionic, Covalent, Co-ordinate, Hydrogen and Metallic), Classification of Solids on the Basis of Bonding and their Properties, Hybridization of Atomic Orbitals and Shapes of Molecules, Molecular Orbitals, Bond Length and Bond Strength.

topics.label: Module 09
topics.title: Chemistry of Transition Elements, Lanthanides and Actinides
topics.summary: Definitions, Electronic Configurations, Preparation (Nuclear Transformation), General Properties.

courses.title: Viva-voce
courses.overview: Comprehensive oral examination (Viva-voce) covering all 1st Year 1st Semester coursework.

topics.label: Module 01
topics.title: Viva-voce Examination
topics.summary: Oral assessment of fundamental concepts across 1st Year 1st Semester courses.
